text:
maya: Quick heads-up: planning a slow canary tomorrow 9:30 PT for feature tortoise-wave. Goal: gradual ramp to 100% over ~2.5h. Who's available to own smoke & rollback? :clock930:

alex: I can own smoke. I'll be oncall that window. What's the exact cohort split?

maya: Thanks @alex. Plan: 1% (internal canary), 5% (NA-west), 20% (NA + EU sample), 50% (global sample), then 100%. Steps paced with metrics checks. Cohort IDs: `c1-internal`, `c2-west5`, `c3-region20`, `c4-global50`.

sahil: Can we do 30m between 5% -> 20%? 20m feels tight

maya: Yep — updated to 30m. New timeline: 1% -> wait 15m -> 5% -> wait 30m -> 20% -> wait 30m -> 50% -> wait 30m -> 100%.

emily: Smoke checklist for @alex:
- run smoke curl
- confirm P99 latency < 400ms
- error rate < 0.5%
- confirm fallback/routes still healthy

emily: curl example:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"prompt":"smoke","max_tokens":5}'
```

alex: :thumbsup: I'll run these and post results here. Will tag @sre on any anomalies.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by maya at 2026-03-19T09:30:00-07:00. Rolling out image: `redwood/tortoise-wave:v2`. smoke-runner flag enabled.

jordan: Rollback plan: feature-flag toggle + traffic-router kill switch. Criteria: >1% absolute increase in errors sustained for 5m OR p99 latency jump >200ms. Who can flip the flag?

alex: I can flip it. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/rollbacks/tortoise-wave

emily: Note: quantized variant only routed on Dedicated. Ensure model fallback mapping to `v1` is set if v2 fails.

maya: Thanks all. @ops-bot please add a reminder 5m before deploy and a post-rollout health check at +1h.

ops-bot: Reminder set 5 minutes before deploy. Post-rollout check scheduled at 10:30 PT.

alex: I'll start smoke at 09:31 PT and paste results. cc @sre
